articles.title: Rebasing the Key Macro Series: From Better Measurement to Better Policy<sup>1</sup> - Inaugural Address by Dr. Poonam Gupta, Deputy Governor, at the ‘Data Users Conference on the new series of GDP, CPI and IIP’, Organised by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) in Mumbai on November 23, 2026 -
articles.summary: It is my pleasure to be here at the Data User Conference on the new GDP, CPI and IIP series.
